title: Capinfer's Survival Enhanced
description: It's like your survival, but enhanced.
body:
![The title of the modpack whit green and red phrases](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d1b7d5f24cbf59f7b0cc4131dda12c213d86782.png)

## Preview
A "Vanilla-Friendly" survival modpack, with some of the best optimization mods, and a great atmosphere with the pre-configured shaders. All of this, whitout losing the original feel of the game, while at the same time adding new challenges and features to the main game

> THIS MODPACK IS MADE THANKS TO AND BASED ON: Vanilla Perfected

A shout out to all the creators of the mods/resource packs/shaders of this modpack!.
